scope: Nine generic techniques tested with short real-media exports; six showcase examples separately verified at 1280x720, 30fps.
additional_checks: failed render preserves existing output and JSON
limits: CFR frame-index timing; VFR not auto-detected
ROI texture tracking does not identify semantic identity
Layered effects require explicit foreground/background/alpha; no automatic multi-view reconstruction
Default audio is silent; retimed and multi-input effects require a separate deliberate sound mix
